evals.prompt: This is a React app using Tailwind. Add a Home icon beside the Home navigation label using Heroicons, and make sure screen readers do not announce the icon twice.
evals.expected_output: Uses the React Heroicons package with a correct 24px outline import, decorative SVG marked aria-hidden, and visible accessible text.

evals.prompt: I have a Vue 3 app and want an icon-only close button in a modal. Use Heroicons and make it accessible.
evals.expected_output: Uses the Vue Heroicons package and gives the button an accessible name while hiding the decorative SVG from assistive technology.

evals.prompt: Add a few icons to this plain HTML landing page without bringing in a JavaScript framework or a large dependency.
evals.expected_output: Recommends official SVG assets or inline SVG, avoids React/Vue dependencies, and preserves viewBox and accessible markup.
